# Cally 0.9.2 (MIT)

Small, accessible calendar web components (`<calendar-date>`, `<calendar-range>`, `<calendar-month>`) by Nick Williams
(https://github.com/WickyNilliams/cally). `cally.js` is `dist/cally.js` of the npm package `cally@0.9.2`: one ES module
with no imports, served as it is. Themed with CSS custom properties and `::part()`.

**Design-system spike only** (`#/lab`): nothing outside the lab imports it yet.

To update: `npm pack cally@<version>` in an empty folder outside the repo and copy `dist/cally.js` and `LICENSE` here.
